title: receiver_count==1 assertion races task startup
description: After app.oneshot(req).await returns, the test asserts tx.receiver_count() == 1 after a single yield_now(). This relies on the default single-threaded tokio test runtime scheduling the spawned coalescing task within one yield. This holds today because tokio's single-threaded scheduler typically runs newly spawned tasks on the next yield point — but this is undocumented scheduler behavior, not a language guarantee. A future tokio version that batches task wakeups differently, or a test run on a multi-threaded runtime, could observe receiver_count() == 0 at that assertion, producing an intermittent false failure. Using a watch channel or a semaphore to signal subscription would eliminate the race.
